new_spots.name: Akaroa Head
new_spots.bio_fix: A clifftop scenic reserve at the mouth of Akaroa Harbour with the foundations of the 1880 lighthouse keepers' homes and a good chance of spotting Hector's dolphins from shore.
new_spots.photo_reason: Real colour photo (March 2018; file name says 1986 but the Commons description gives 2018) of the Akaroa Heads headland across turquoise water; the DOC danger sign is in the corner but not the subject. Right place (sign reads Akaroa Heads). Scenic enough, slightly plain sky.

new_spots.name: Okains Bay Museum
new_spots.photo_reason: Real colour photo of the museum's whare taonga and marae buildings against the hills; the building complex is the attraction, so check 2 and 3 pass. Right place per Commons description (Okains Bay Māori and Colonial Museum). Note for the writer: the museum site shows seasonal hours (winter, from 1 May, weekends only; summer Thu-Mon 10-4), so 'closedDays [2,3]' is the summer pattern; say 'Thu-Mon in summer, weekends in winter' in hours.

existing_fixes.reason: Only Wikivoyage (undated) supports Mon-Fri; the museum's own site (akaroamuseum.org.nz) returned no readable content, so the change is unverified. Leave the current hours until the museum's own page confirms them.
